summary: Read-only M1 readiness audit completed for registry/census scope using targeted regression only (16 live API + 24 offline contract + UI route/fidelity smoke). Backend scoped registry path is healthy; frontend census-history fidelity remains materially divergent from owner reference.

ui_bugs.issue: Detail tabs diverge from owner reference model: current labels are Discovery/GPU spend/Conversation/Evidence while expected Discovery Summary/GPU Spend/Conversation with Agent/Discovery Details.
Designed discovery groups Coverage/Condition/Readiness are absent; current groups render Inventory/Execution outcome.
Multiple entries show as 'Census #undefined' (record label defect still present in current live UI).

issues: Owner census reference structure is materially reduced (missing all three designed grouped sections in discovery).
Current UI remains functional but does not satisfy exact-reference fidelity for census history detail.

action_items: Restore owner-reference census history detail taxonomy and labels (Discovery Summary/GPU Spend/Conversation with Agent/Discovery Details + Coverage/Condition/Readiness groups).
Fix history record labeling path to avoid 'Census #undefined' in list rows.
Keep /api/registry/facts scoped 200 and avoid regressing it into blanket legacy 409 handling.
critical_code_review_comments: D3 verification: DataEstates.jsx and DAPLanding.jsx still contain fictional Digicow figures but are not mounted by current App.js routes; live /dap and /dap/estates/:id are served through OwnerDAPLayout + scoped model.

Legacy/unbound route boundary is selective and correct in this slice: /api/portal/census/assets returns 409 while /api/registry/facts and /api/portal/census/overview return 200 for authenticated scoped access.
OwnerOSPage correctly binds to generated/os.json (not a replacement dashboard shell).

Prototype source integrity check passed: nexus.html SHA256 remains 0330a1712aad3b76dfe6f5e97207707fa35a1ed774a134313635a59ba0a67d3d; frontend generated nexus-fragments source_sha256 matches and contains no 'registry' fragment payload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Targeted evidence-only rerun used to avoid whole-suite repetition. Live checks: 16/16 API pass, 24/24 offline contract pass, /api/registry/facts scoped 200, /api/portal/census/assets 409. UI still fails owner-fidelity on history detail labels/groups and retains Census #undefined rows.
rca of the issue: History detail divergence is code-level in frontend model mapping: historyModel.js explicitly defines simplified tabs (Discovery/GPU spend/Conversation/Evidence) and discovery groups (Inventory + Execution outcome), so owner-reference grouped taxonomy cannot render. Census #undefined appears because list display falls back to census_run_id when census_number/record mapping is incomplete for some run records.
